nodes.label: icon-512.png (Boxy PWA icon 512x512)
nodes.description: 512x512 PWA manifest icon: bold white sans-serif letter 'B' centered on a flat, full-bleed green square (#16a34a-like), no rounded corners or padding. Generated with PHP GD; used by the installable Boxy web app (Chrome/Edge install, add to home screen).

nodes.label: Boxy 'B' Monogram Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: Minimal visible brand identity for the Boxy SaaS product: single-letter monogram in the brand green (matches manifest theme_color #16a34a) keeps the icon legible at small sizes and reflects that only the visible brand is Boxy while internals keep the 'crotone' name.
